About me

A researcher.
An engineer.
A collaborator.

Cloud & edgeApplied AIResearch software

My work has taken me from robot-server systems and telecom analytics to a PhD on dynamic microservices at the University of Melbourne.

Today, I bring that systems perspective to wearable R&D, AI workflows, teaching, and industry project supervision. I enjoy understanding the idea, building the mechanism, and examining what the evidence supports.
